evidence.evidence_text: Method: This paper introduces a novel corpus, "Colloquial Persian POS" (CPPOS), specifically designed to support colloquial Persian text.
A comparison with another well-known Persian POS corpus named "Bijankhan" and the Persian Hazm POS tool trained on Bijankhan revealed that our model trained on CPPOS outperforms them.

Results: To evaluate the quality of CPPOS, various deep learning models, such as the RNN family, were trained using the constructed corpus.
